notes.title: Patch 20.5.9
notes.content:
Well hello there!

Hope you're all having A December 🎄

The golf... santa... came into our office, drank a few coffees and then fixed a few bugs. Very strange man. Anyways here's some Patch Notes for a cheeky little fix that came early this week!

[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]

[h3]Secret Saw Achievement[/h3]
So sorry for all the distress concerning this bug and achievement! It unlocks retroactively now - [b]but players will still need to enter the main campaign.[/b]

[h3]Computer 03 Achievement didn't unlock[/h3]
It now unlocks retroactively. Maybe there was some issue that stopped it from triggering when it should.
Players will still need to enter the main campaign to trigger this.

[h3]Players get stuck in a [strike]Mario [/strike] little plumber guy level[/h3]
It was breakable by spamming the shoot button so we've not brought in a plumber and disabling input while you’re in the pipe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32091497/40ccf405285c6147ac76b5a8074a74c0a28916b3.gif[/img]

[h1]NEXT EVENT: LET'S PAR-TEE[/h1]
The next event is gonna take place over NEW YEARS 🎉🍾🥂
from December 23rd until Jan 5th

notes.title: What The Golf? is getting a free update with 50 new levels to golf holes in
notes.content:
Unorthodox non-sporting game What The Golf? is hitting the green again and bringing a heck of a lot more holes. An upcoming free update is adding 50 new levels and approximately 1000 new holes. The A Hole New World update has already launched on the Apple Arcade and is coming to PC and Switch versions "in the next few weeks," the developers say.

Read more

notes.title: WHAT THE GOLF? Steam trading cards are here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32091497/048e0ce5c7ca87da1fc9eb8fe627ff28a04ad1a3.png[/img]

[b]We are happy to announce that WHAT THE GOLF? now has Steam trading cards! [/b]

Earn cards by playing the game and trading with your fellow golf haters. Once you gather a full set you will be able to craft a badge that you can display on your Steam profile. Each badge will earn you random drops containing profile backgrounds and emotes.

Here’s all the items that can be unlocked with trading cards!
[list]
[*][b]Regular badges (Max of 5)[/b]
[*][b]3 WTG related profile backgrounds[/b]
[*][b]Rare Foil badge (1 level)[/b]
[*][b]6 WTG related Emojis! [/b]
[/list]

There are 15 cards in total so do your best to collect them all! 

[b]Happy Hunting![/b]

notes.title: WHAT THE GOLF? IT'S SNOWTIME Update
notes.content:
Is your favorite ski resort closed?😱
It's all going to be OK, because your IT'S SNOWTIME! Update is finally here. 
Complete with snowpals, moose, cars, ice cubes and pizza of course. We even added snow to make it look like golf.  

We hope you enjoy the new levels 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32091497/d5910cde0f71657c287a1e31c88ed512941d94e0.gif[/img]

Happy Holiday from Triband 
🍕🎅🤶🍍⛄🐴🎁🚗❄🔥⛳

notes.title: We made it!
notes.content:
[h1]YAY! We reached our crowdfunding goal[/h1]
To celebrate we made two extra playable levels in our downloadable prototype. It’s a tribute too [b]SUPERHOT[/b] and [b]Clustertruck[/b]. Two of our all-time indie game favorites. 

We give you [b]SUPERPUTT[/b] and [b]Clusterputt![/b]

Go here to [url=https://www.fig.co/campaigns/what-the-golf] download the demo [/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32091497/c35d35ebc78b442dfc7a80026a777ea9ff8b3e54.gif[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32091497/2910c0ecffa8b10434c7302d07d554cba4b018be.gif[/img]
All games are golf games:)

Thanks for all the support. 
We 🏌️ you.
